name: mcsr-vid
description: Turns an MCSR Ranked match into a synced dual-POV video with a split-timer overlay: VOD download, countdown sync, Remotion overlay, Kdenlive project or headless MP4.

scripts.remotion:studio: npm run build-overlay-css && remotion studio remotion/index.ts
scripts.//still: Render one frame of a composition to PNG — the fast visual check before a full render.
scripts.still: npm run build-overlay-css && remotion still remotion/index.ts
scripts.//validate-project: Load a generated .kdenlive through the MLT engine; exit 0 = parses, 1 = malformed XML.
scripts.//export:nvenc: GPU-encode the timeline to out/export.mp4 (h264_nvenc); append out=48 for a short range.
scripts.export:nvenc: melt-7 -consumer avformat:out/export.mp4 vcodec=h264_nvenc preset=p5 cq=23 acodec=aac ab=192k
scripts.//analytics: YouTube Analytics for a published video, via the claude-youtube skill outside this repo.
scripts.//archive: Copy a finished match to the NAS. Copies, never moves - nothing is deleted.
scripts.//test: test:unit is every *.test.ts except the three that drive Chromium or ffmpeg; test runs those after it.
scripts.test:unit: for f in $(find src remotion -name '*.test.ts' | sort); do case "$f" in */overlayRender.test.ts|*/exportFrames.test.ts) continue;; esac; echo "-- $f --"; tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && for f in src/pipeline/overlayRender.test.ts src/exportFrames.test.ts; do echo "-- $f --"; tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.//series: A playoff series as one video: every game rendered, joined into game 1's series-<id>.mp4.
scripts.//sync-status: Where each match's clips are placed; with an id, backfills sync.json from an already-generated .kdenlive.
scripts.//retention: Audience retention curve per video from the Analytics API — where the viewers leave.
scripts.//pick: Have the model (reasonerCommand) watch the finished video and pick the Short's window; prints the prompt size, the raw answer and why it was rejected. <matchId|all> [--force]
